knowledge.plain_language_summary: A retrofit of an existing campus entrance sign: new Equitone Lunara textured concrete-tile cladding (peaked for runoff) over the existing structure, with 1/2in and 1/4in waterjet-cut aluminum logo and letters stud-mounted to the existing brick, plus an accent-lighting retrofit.
knowledge.rationale: Re-cladding an existing entrance with Equitone tile and waterjet letters modernizes it without rebuilding; accent lighting gives a night read.

structure.construction: Equitone Lunara textured concrete-tile cladding over existing structure (peaked), 1/2in waterjet aluminum logo + 1/4in waterjet aluminum letters stud-mounted to existing brick, accent lighting retrofit (~10A)

craft_observations: Equitone tile re-clad + waterjet letters modernizes an existing entrance without rebuild.
